bio:
Nora C. Heffernan (Jul 1873 - 14 Jun 1964), unmarried, died at Wilkes-Barre.

FamilySearch gives her birth as 20 Jul 1873. In 1900 "Norah," 26, was a dressmaker living with her parents in Plymouth ([R4-S9]); in 1940 she lived in Kingston ([R4-S1]).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh

[R4-S1] FamilySearch Family Tree (published), Nora C Heffernan (1873-1964), PID LTDC-3QD; user-contributed tree with attached record index entries (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/LTDC-3QD
